description: Reviewed, intentional changes to protected production files. A protected file that differs from the validated baseline is accepted only when BOTH its baseline hash and its current hash match an entry here; any other edit still makes a test INVALID. Add an entry only after the change's tests pass.

changes.title: hold-and-resume default (stale_resume_s = 2 s) plus actuator-model stop reasons and physical-stop reporting
changes.summary: Adds hold-and-resume as the default freshness-watchdog response. The trip is unchanged: zero velocity at the same moment and image age. With stale_resume_s > 0 (default 2 s) the alignment is paused, resumes on the next fresh frame, and ends as stale_camera only if none arrives within stale_resume_s. stale_resume_s = 0 restores the original stop exactly. Adds counters watchdog_pauses, watchdog_resumes, paused_s, paused_motion_ticks and pause/resume events. Rationale and evidence: docs/WATCHDOG_DECISION.md. 2026-09-30: stop/pause/shutdown pass their reason to Simulation.command_velocity; stop, pause and resume events record a command_serial; RealtimeSession(actuator=...) selects the actuator profile; report() adds 'actuator', 'motion' and 'motion_evicted'. Watchdog logic and timing are unchanged.

supersedes.title: freshness watchdog hold-and-resume, default on (stale_resume_s = 2 s; 0 = original stop)

changes.title: actuator dynamics between command and servo; physical stop measurement
changes.summary: Adds the simulated actuator dynamics model (actuator.py, actuator_config.json; docs/ACTUATOR_MODEL.md) between the guarded velocity command and MuJoCo's velocity servos: acceleration, deceleration and jerk limits; profile 'ideal' passes the command through unchanged. Every stop, hold, collision block and shutdown still zeroes the command at the same moment; the physical braking that follows is measured (Simulation.motion_log). The joint-limit backstop now triggers earlier by the remaining stopping distance (zero with 'ideal'). command_velocity() takes an optional stop reason. velocity_command keeps its meaning.

changes.title: new: actuator dynamics model
changes.summary: Adds the simulated actuator dynamics model (actuator.py, actuator_config.json; docs/ACTUATOR_MODEL.md) between the guarded velocity command and MuJoCo's velocity servos: acceleration, deceleration and jerk limits; profile 'ideal' passes the command through unchanged. Every stop, hold, collision block and shutdown still zeroes the command at the same moment; the physical braking that follows is measured (Simulation.motion_log). Rejects a profile that brakes slower than the collision guard's braking_time_s assumes.

changes.title: new: actuator profiles (ideal, default, gentle)
changes.summary: Assumed limits, not drive data: default 2 rad/s^2 acceleration, 5 rad/s^2 deceleration, 150 rad/s^3 jerk; standstill below 0.001 rad/s for 20 ms; servo lag allowance 15 ms.
